allowedWork: Compositor dependency attribution, ephemeral scene-plan ownership, independently measured budgets, behavior-preserving caller migrations, typed balanced-operation declarations and corpus, explicit-base logarithm semantics, one change-of-base exemplar, verification, project memory, and closeout.
disallowedWork: Ceiling increases, hidden code, visual changes to existing callers, second clocks or renderers, universal CAS operations, inferred truth from glyphs, unrelated families or product layout, and user-owned economics or unrelated documentation.
goal: Restore honestly measured native-KaTeX compositor ownership without visual change, consolidate verified both-sides operations through one governed family, and deliver one review-ready alternative-base logarithm exemplar.
commitCadence: Commit every independently reversible verified slice with exact path staging and completed Theseus evidence.
stopConditions: Stop if existing semantic or visual behavior changes outside the new exemplar.
Stop if the failed compositor gate can only be cleared by raising a ceiling, hiding bytes, or weakening aggregate or bundle attribution.
Stop if the work introduces a second renderer, clock, scheduler, lifecycle, or paint vocabulary.
Stop if both-sides generalization accepts unverified algebra, erases distinct domain assumptions, or grows a central closed switch.
Stop if log-base work expands into arbitrary logarithm or CAS support.
Stop if user-owned dirty files overlap required edits.
Always stop for explicit human visual judgment at s28; s29 requires later approval.

slices.title: Freeze compositor baseline and evidence
slices.summary: Frozen exact four-owner and twenty-dependency source baseline, generated direct caller graph, production manifest and native-motion bundle attribution, and accepted glyph/reader behavior evidence without changing runtime code.

slices.title: Classify compositor ownership
slices.summary: Added an exact-set ownership ledger for twelve compositor responsibilities, legal target effects, forbidden cross-layer authority, and live source evidence covering all four owners and twenty dependencies.

slices.title: Define ephemeral renderer-ready scene plan
slices.summary: Defined and validated a non-serializable renderer-session-only scene-plan contract with measured endpoints, reconciliation, hierarchy, paint-measured tracks, protected transit, disposition, and supplemental owner sampling but no clock or apply authority.

slices.title: Measure planner and aggregate closures
slices.summary: Added disjoint source budgets for canonical core, scene-plan boundary, renderer support, and their unique aggregate; all new budgets pass while the unchanged direct-dependency budget remains intentionally visible.

slices.title: Extract reconciliation hierarchy and base tracks
slices.summary: Extracted pure reconciliation, hierarchy, and base-track compilation behind the preserved compositor API; all 73 glyph tests and architecture/type gates pass, while the known direct-dependency byte debt stays visible for s13.

slices.title: Extract semantic motion and track projection
slices.summary: Moved semantic-motion and track-projection application behind the pure base-plan port, removed compositor imports of three semantic modules, restored the unchanged 295000-byte direct gate at 293609 bytes, and preserved all canonical, glyph, and log fixtures.

slices.title: Move operation choreography behind typed port
slices.summary: Routed operation choreography through the base-plan typed port, removed direct compositor authority, updated the architectural ratchet, and preserved all 186 operation plans plus the canonical source gate.

slices.title: Move successor synthesis planning upstream
slices.summary: Moved successor synthesis compilation and claimed-track partitioning upstream while retaining measured owner composition and sampling in the renderer; operation, glyph, canonical, type, architecture, and fixed ownership budgets all pass.

slices.title: Move collision reorder and fan-in orchestration
slices.summary: Moved collision-safe transit, semantic reorder, and quality-bounded fan-in behind the base scene-plan port, reduced the exact direct dependency closure from 16 modules to 14 without raising any ceiling, and preserved all 301 focused motion and operation checks.

slices.title: Converge planner and renderer facades
slices.summary: Converged the nominal renderer-ready contract into the single scene-plan authority, added one canonical compiler facade feeding the existing renderer facade, removed the superseded standalone plan module and compatibility exports, preserved old input callers through the same path, and kept every fixed source and bundle gate green.

slices.title: Migrate exhaustive reader adapter
slices.summary: Migrated the exhaustive reader adapter to compile exactly one nominal renderer-ready plan and render that exact object through the native KaTeX feature pack; preserved the nine-way closed presentation dispatch, static checkpoints, runtime scheduling, accessibility-responsive browser behavior, and fixed compositor ceilings while moving stale plan-only imports to their true scene-plan authority.

slices.title: Migrate catalogue and feature-pack callers
slices.summary: Migrated catalogue exact-symbolic, log-exponent, and place-value native-KaTeX feature-pack callers to compile a single nominal renderer-ready plan before session creation; added a caller ratchet and preserved lazy capability loading, bundle attribution, all direct-seek and rewind laws, and the full catalogue browser host.

slices.title: Retire dead entries and restore source gates
slices.summary: Retired the proven-dead raw scene-input renderer compatibility entry, migrated the remaining radical, log-product, and log-quotient direct callers to explicit compile-then-render handoffs, preserved runtime nominal validation, and restored every fixed compositor source gate with the exact direct closure at 154706/295000 bytes and aggregate at 454943/455000 without raising a ceiling.

slices.title: Verify compositor boundary
slices.summary: Closed Tranche A with one compile-plan/render-session boundary across editor, reader, and feature-pack hosts; deterministic ownership, preservation, architecture, type, build, bundle, and fixed source-budget gates pass. Broad browser debt remains explicit: seven glyph checks and the radical parity readiness failure reproduce unchanged at pre-tranche b5f75e14, while the equation-surface browser gate retains its ResizeObserver environment failure.

slices.title: Inventory balanced operation callers
slices.summary: Added a generated, exact caller inventory for add, subtract, multiply, divide, apply-natural-log, and divide-by-log-base across semantic authority, laws, assumptions, common roles, presentation routes, authoring exposure, and literal source discovery. The inventory makes three adoption gaps explicit and rejects contradictory authorities, duplicate evidence, stale source claims, and new orphan callers.

slices.title: Define typed both-sides family
slices.summary: Defined and verified a framework-neutral, data-only both-sides equality-operation family for add, subtract, multiply, divide, and injective-function application. The closed union couples each operation to its exact law and domain-evidence shape, requires total distinct lhs/rhs roles, brands only verifier output, and rejects callbacks, presentation policy, unsafe zero-sensitive operations, mismatched function evidence, and fabricated authority in runtime and type fixtures.

slices.title: Define shared causal recipe
slices.summary: Added a verified four-phase both-sides causal recipe that projects only prepare-branches, synchronized application/withdrawal, equality continuity, and endpoint settlement from branded semantic authority. Forward and rewind exchange exact endpoints and preserve branch/application identity; the recipe admits no timing, geometry, topology, routes, or optics, and all 187 existing operation plus 53 log-exponent checks remain unchanged.

slices.title: Register additive callers
slices.summary: Registered addBothSides and subtractBothSides through one data-only pack and one closed registry; compiled existing semantic correspondence and balanced branch scheduling into the verified causal recipe without changing presentation paint; added compiler-owned correspondence for generated additive fixtures while preserving their legacy selector identity; and closed law, branch, generated-fixture, architecture, type, renderer, and source-budget checks.

slices.title: Register multiplicative callers
slices.summary: Registered multiplyBothSides and divideBothSides through one data-only multiplicative pack and the verified shared causal recipe. Added explicit nonzero proof obligations, generated division correspondence, and one reusable equation branch-role index that prefers semantic side IDs and safely recovers legacy ordered equations. Fraction construction, balanced entry, cancellation, exact arithmetic, native paint, and all accepted choreography remain caller-owned and unchanged; 26 focused, 187 presentation, and 64 fraction-architecture checks pass.

slices.title: Register logarithmic callers
slices.summary: Registered applyNaturalLogBothSides and divideBothSidesByLogBase through one data-only logarithmic pack and registration-owned application-selection protocol. The injective-function operation carries exact positive-domain and injectivity evidence; division binds the same ln(base) semantic divisor across lhs source and rhs denominator occurrences with nonzero evidence. Exact equation-tree branch roles feed the shared causal recipe while canonical function-wrap, exponent-transit, rigid-compound, quotient, timing, seek/rewind, and paint contracts remain unchanged; 57 semantic/motion checks pass and the isolated Firefox narrow reduced-motion retry is green after one full-matrix readiness timeout.

slices.title: Expose governed authoring surface
slices.summary: Exposed all six registered both-sides transformations through one framework-neutral equation-series authoring family. Exact operation and semantic-source pins, four canonical branch/relation/application roles, and declaration-owned assumption evidence now compile transactionally; missing or mismatched pins, sources, entities, roles, assumptions, raw prose authority, and renderer fields return distinct typed repairs while retaining the last valid candidate. The CLI and planner catalogue expose requirements without granting the model mathematical authority, and the balanced caller inventory now reports zero authoring gaps.

slices.title: Add balanced-operation corpus
slices.summary: Added a deterministic framework-neutral corpus with six governed successes across add, subtract, multiply, divide, apply-log, and divide-by-log-base using distinct operand shapes. Four adversarial fixtures prove exact fail-closed repairs for unavailable nonzero evidence, unavailable log-domain evidence, ambiguous operation selection, and compound jumps requiring intermediate states. Every invalid case yields one stable typed repair, no active runtime, and no renderer or timing input; the existing transform-series corpus remains unchanged and green.

slices.title: Recompute coverage evidence
slices.summary: Promoted balanced operations to Direct only after exact family, recipe, authoring, corpus, exemplar, and deterministic compiler evidence aligned; retained the not-live-model evidence tension and corrected the planned corpus scope to six governed operations.
